title: Adaptive progressive-disable and microcopy for clustered icon actions
creator: Aisha Verma
description:
Problem:
Clustered icon actions (multi-icon FABs, compact split-button icon clusters, and stacked quick actions) currently use a binary enabled/disabled model. During async flows we need a softer, progressively degraded state so the primary action remains discoverable while secondary actions become interruptible or visually de-emphasized. Additionally, microcopy (screen-reader labels, live-region hints) is inconsistent across sizes and themes which leads to confusing announcements when an action transitions into a pending or throttled state. Regressions after the token migration caused spinner overlap and compressed hitboxes in dark theme for compact clusters.

Goal:
Design an adaptive "progressive-disable" pattern with theme-aware tokens and a microcopy system for clustered icon actions that: preserves discoverability of primary actions, provides clear a11y announcements for state transitions, avoids layout shift and spinner overlap, and can be toggled as an opt-in upgrade for existing components.

Acceptance criteria:
- New progressive-disable visual spec for clustered icon actions (soft-disabled overlay, subtle blur/opacity + retain pointer events for primary when configured).
- Microcopy set defined (default/concise/verbose) and ARIA guidelines included for aria-label/aria-live for pending/interruptible states.
- Token set added/updated: icon-gap, spinner-offset, soft-disable-opacity, soft-disable-border, microcopy-variant tokens, with theme variants for light/dark/high-contrast.
- Design tokens avoid introducing breaking layout deltas; ensure no spinner overlaps icon glyph at smallest sizes (24px).
- Figma file with component variants, redlines, and example flows (idle -> pending -> soft-disabled -> fully-disabled).
- Engineering acceptance: storybook stories for clustered icon actions, unit tests for ARIA announcements, visual regression snapshots across themes.
- Regression tests added for previously observed token migration issues (DES-120246).
design_notes:
- Propose three visual tiers:
  1) Idle: full color, normal elevation.
  2) Pending-soft: retain icon contrast for primary; secondary icons get 40% opacity and a 2px inset overlay. Spinner aligned to outer ring using token spinner-offset.
  3) Fully-disabled: legacy disabled state (no pointer events, reduced contrast).
- Microcopy variants: default ("Action pending"), concise ("Saving…"), verbose ("Saving draft — cancel available"). Prominent copy only used for primary on tablet/desktop; assistive-only for small icon-only controls to avoid visual clutter.
- Token naming convention: button.icon.cluster.soft_disable_opacity, button.icon.cluster.spinner_offset, button.icon.cluster.primary_focus_ring. Keep token scope narrow to make opt-in safer.
- Accessibility: announce transitions with role="status" aria-live="polite" for non-blocking flows and assert a11y text updates in storybook with axe checks.
- Edge cases: stacked clusters where vertical motion must be avoided; prefer opacity overlay over translation to avoid layout shift.
engineering_notes:
- Implement CSS variables mapping to the new tokens; provide a fallback mapping to legacy tokens if token is missing.
- Add two new class modifiers: .cluster--pending-soft and .cluster--pending-hard.
- Spinner placement: use absolute positioning with token-driven offsets; ensure RTL parity.
- Storybook: create stories for size variants (24/32/40 px), theme variants (light/dark/high-contrast), and behavioral flows (idle -> pending-soft -> cancel -> fully-disabled).
- Tests: visual snapshot (Chromatic), a11y check (axe), unit test for aria-live updates and keyboard focus behavior when primary remains active.
- Back-compat flag: add feature flag design.tokens.clusterProgressiveDisable to gate rollout for Dedicated and Private consumers that rely on exact visual parity.
- Link to placeholder PR when available and coordinate with platform infra owners on token rollout schedule.
qa_checklist:
- Verify spinner does not overlap icon at 24px in light/dark/HC.
- Verify aria-live announces appropriate microcopy variant on state change.
- Keyboard navigation: focus ring persists on primary when secondaries are soft-disabled.
- Ensure no layout shift when entering soft-pending state on narrow containers.
- Visual snapshots match design across themes.
- Confirm feature flag disables new tokens and falls back cleanly.
rollout_plan:
1) Merge design tokens PR behind feature flag.
2) Implement component class modifiers and stories; QA within Design System cycle.
3) Run visual/regression suite; address DES-120246 regressions.
4) Enable for small percentage of internal product routes for 2 weeks, monitor console telemetry for regressions.
5) Full release in design-system-2026.04 if no critical issues.
Note: Communicate token change notes in the design-system changelog and include migration snippet for product teams.
